question: When a vector-dependent rank-one rational lift rule is fixed before fresh public queries, is its second reduction check equivalent to the public group relation, with all attempts charged?
base_curve: E/F_p: y^2=x^3-x-2; exact G and prime subgroup q from the pinned registry
target_law: for j=0,1,2,3, let w=1+SHA256('xedni-precommitted-v1|p|j') interpreted big-endian modulo (q-1), and Q=wG; fixture construction is outside the attempt phase
query_law: offset list [0,1,2,3,5,8,13,21]; for each field and target, take the first 16 lexicographic ordered distinct offsets (t1,t2) with U=Q-t1G and V=Q-t2G both nonidentity
selected_attempts: for every query use all 13 selected public coefficient vectors in saved order; 8 fields times 4 targets times 16 queries times 13 vectors = 6656 attempts
precommitted_construction: for vector (a,b) with b invertible mod q, compute finite T=b^-1 U without testing aU+bV; center T's affine coordinates (x,y), set B=y^2-x^3+x and E_B/Q:y^2=x^3-x+B, P=(x,y), A=bP, C=-aP; check nonsingularity, good reduction, the rational relation aA+bC=O, and both reductions A=U,C=V
acceptance: accept exactly when all construction and reduction checks pass; separately compute public aU+bV=O after construction as an independently recorded diagnostic, and verify acceptance equivalence
controls: after selected attempts, for each target use vector (1,2) and offsets t1=0,t2=(3w)/2 mod q as a planted public-relation positive control; use the first t2+k mod q, k>=1, with distinct nonidentity U,V and false public relation as a negative control; controls are separate from selected yield
cost_accounting: record every attempted vector, rational model construction, scalar multiplication, reduction check, acceptance/rejection, and public diagnostic; no isolated wall-time comparison
falsifiers: rational model or point construction fails
accepted row lacks the public relation
public relation row fails either reduction check
positive or negative control disagrees with its frozen status
formal_goal: prove in Lean the reduction-check iff public-relation implication with an explicit injectivity hypothesis on multiplication by b in the finite target group; leave actual elliptic-curve reduction-map instantiation explicit if unavailable
